patch_description: Replace the per-qubit parameterized linear-chain ansatz with an interleaved hypercube brick-wall design. The 12 CZ edges of the 3-cube are decomposed into 3 disjoint perfect matchings (bit-0, bit-1, bit-2 edges), with shared RY rotations inserted between each matching. This creates a 3-layer entangling structure that is much more expressive than applying all CZs in one block, while keeping all parameters shared across qubits (7 unique params per block = 44 total) to ensure strong generalization. The design maintains full hypercube connectivity for equal qubit treatment.
